name: NeverFall
fix_description: In sell, uses manipulable on-chain values for pricing. Fix: use TWAP or oracle.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short but protocol-specific multi-step attack: take a flash loan, use one contract buy, route a large swap through Pancake to a specific recipient, then exploit the target’s sell logic and repay. It requires understanding the NeverFall token mechanics and how the creator-directed swap manipulates state/pricing, so it is more than a trivial pattern but not a deeply complex attack chain.
